firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently saw a ghost starts. A ghost in a film, television show, or illustration counts if no one has seen one in real life.
clarifications: The two-player rules alternate the starting player in later rounds.
The three-player and four-player team variants refer back to the two-player rules for play order, with their own clockwise or team-turn instructions.
internalEvidence: The Artipia product page links the publisher's four-page English rulebook. Its indexed text confirms the ghost criterion, the three-player instruction to use the two-player rules with clockwise order, and the four-player instruction to use the two-player rules with clockwise and alternating-team order. The Artipia-branded eight-page retailer mirror was also retrieved and visually inspected; its pagination differs.
